description.value: Dante Italian Sandwich is a Vancouver sandwich shop serving Italian-style sandwiches piled high on house-made schiacciata bread, with premium ingredients including prosciutto, mortadella, stracciatella cheese, and house-prepared spreads. The Commercial Drive location is one of three outposts across the city, sitting on one of Vancouver's most vibrant and cyclist-frequented streets. Touring cyclists will find a focused, quality-driven menu with vegetarian options and a no-frills fast-food format suited to a quick, satisfying stop.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 63m; rack at 88m; rack at 98m; rack at 99m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is a real, operating multi-location sandwich shop with a Commercial Drive location at 1110 Commercial Dr. matching the OSM record. The phone number 604.336.4604 listed on the website for the Commercial location matches OSM's +1-604-336-4604. Takeout is confirmed via 'ORDER PICKUP ORDER DELIVERY' on the locations page; vegetarian options are explicitly labeled on the menu ('il veg', 'il caprese'). The OSM social media tags (Facebook: 'thepizzacastleandindiancurry', Instagram: 'thepizzacastle') are clearly from a different business and flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM postal code (V5L 3X2) does not match the website's listing for the Commercial Drive location (V5L 2N1); website value used as more authoritative.

OSM tags contact:facebook='thepizzacastleandindiancurry' and contact:instagram='thepizzacastle' clearly belong to a different business (Pizza Castle / Indian Curry) and appear to be erroneous OSM data attached to this node.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible fast-food sandwich shop on Commercial Drive with a confirmed website and matching phone number. A straightforward include.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly labels 'il veg' (eggplant, zucchini, roasted red pepper, fresh mozzarella) and 'il caprese' (tomato, fresh basil, fresh mozzarella) as Vegetarian. Vegan cashew mozzarella substitution also available
